min_free_kbytes.description: Minimum free memory (in KiB) threshold to trigger action

log_level.description: Log verbosity level: debug, info, warning, error

enabled.description: Enable custom notification actions (e.g., email, scripts)

notify_script.description: Path to a script executed when low memory is detected

email_recipients.description: List of email addresses to notify on low-memory events

min_free_kbytes_threshold.description: More urgent free-memory threshold (KiB) that triggers alerts

kill_process.description: Automatically kill low-priority processes under memory pressure

kill_process_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match process names for auto-termination

kill_process_min_age_sec.description: Minimum age (seconds) for a process to be considered for termination

monitor_processes.description: List of processes to track and report (excluded from auto-kill)

name.description: Process name or pattern (exact match or regex)
